subject: Request: One-off invoicing cadence & Net-90 consideration for Flagship Systems
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Cc: Stella Moreno <stella@flagshipsys.com>

Subject: Request: One-off invoicing cadence & Net-90 consideration for Flagship Systems

Laura / Neha — looping you in on a payment-term request from Flagship. Quick context: Flagship (annual contract, $480k ARR) has a procurement policy requiring quarterly invoicing for multi-year platform purchases and prefers Net-90 on large initial invoices to align with their internal budget cycles. Stella (procurement) copied.

They've signed the SOW (attached SOW_Flagship_v3.pdf) and want us to: 1) invoice in 4 quarterly invoices (equal split), and 2) NET-90 on each invoice (they will pay within 90 days of each invoice date).

Why they're asking: central finance does quarterly processing and they cannot accommodate a single upfront annual invoice. If we push back they'll consider delaying start-of-contract by one quarter. Deal is high strategic value (logo + reference).

Requesting: a one-off approval for this invoicing cadence and Net-90 terms for Flagship. If credit checks / additional assurances are needed we can add milestone-based invoicing, or require a signed amendment with termination/late-fee language. Also open to discussing a small prepayment (10%) if that helps.

Attachments: SOW_Flagship_v3.pdf (attached), draft amendment placeholder.

Asks:
- Laura: can Finance approve quarterly invoices + Net-90 for this account?
- Neha: any legal or Rev-Ops gating items we should include?
- If not approveable, what's the maximum term we can accept (Net-60? Net-30 + schedule)?

Thanks,
Priyom

Subject: Re: Request: One-off invoicing cadence & Net-90 consideration for Flagship Systems

Priyom — thanks for the context and the SOW. A few items from Finance's perspective:

1) Quarterly invoicing is operationally OK; we can generate four invoices split evenly.
2) Net-90 is outside our standard credit terms for new customers of this size. We typically approve Net-60 at most for deals over $250k for customers with established payment history.
3) To consider Net-90 we need: a) a credit reference check, b) signed amendment that includes late payment interest (per policy) and c) a fallback clause that moves terms back to Net-30 if two consecutive invoices are late.

Given Flagship is a strategic logo and you indicate risk of start delay, escalate to revenue leadership for an exception beyond Net-60. Vivek — can you review and, if you agree, escalate to Markus (finance exec) for final approval? If approved, we'll prepare amendment language and coordinate with Rev-Ops for billing setup.

Also copying Stella's procurement so they see the gating items.

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Finance | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 14:56:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: One-off invoicing cadence & Net-90 consideration for Flagship Systems

Markus — forwarding Priyom's ask and Laura's note. TL;DR: Flagship is asking for 4 quarterly invoices and Net-90 on each. Deal = $480k ARR (annual), reference customer potential.

My read: risk of delaying start if we insist on Net-30/Net-60. The account has good references; they've been responsive and want to close this week. I'm OK granting an exception with controls. Proposal for approval:

- Approve quarterly invoicing (4 equal invoices).
- Approve Net-90 for the first two invoices only. After that, move to Net-60 for remaining invoices.
- Require: signed amendment (limit liability language + late fee clause), 10% upfront retention credit withheld until Q2 payment received.
- Rev-Ops to set automated reminder cadence and flag any invoice >45 days past due to AR team.

If you approve, Finance should conditionally accept and Revenue Ops will prepare the amendment & billing schedule. This balances commercial need and collections risk.

Markus — can you sign off on the proposed conditions? If yes, Laura please draft amendment and route to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Americas | Redwood Inference

Agree with Vivek's compromise and approve the exception with the following firm conditions: 

1) Invoice schedule: 4 equal quarterly invoices.
2) Payment terms: Net-90 for Invoice 1 and Invoice 2 only; Invoice 3 and 4 revert to Net-60.
3) Financial safeguard: 10% retention on first invoice (we collect and hold; release after Q2 payment is received).
4) Contractual controls: signed amendment that includes late payment interest (1.5% monthly), fallback to Net-30 after two late payments, and executive termination right if account becomes 90 days delinquent.
5) Rev-Ops to create AR playbook for this account and set automated escalation at 45/75 days.

Laura: please prepare the amendment (Flagship_Amendment_Draft.docx), route for internal review, and send to Flagship via DocuSign (link in related_links). Priyom: once doc is sent, confirm timeline with Stella so we can schedule onboarding.

Markus Klein

- We will hold a 10% retention on the first invoice and release it after Q2 payment confirmation.

Next steps for Flagship: please confirm you accept these conditions so we can route the amendment. I'll attach the draft amendment to the DocuSign envelope once Laura flags it ready.
